title: mingti-org/phyai
abstract:
PhyAI is a high-performance framework for running Physical AI models (VLA, WAM, and beyond), supporting both cloud-based serving and on-device deployment.

---- **PhyAI** (pronounced "phi") is a **latency-first serving engine for Physical AI**. It is designed first for latency critical workloads, such as policy and action models that run in interactive systems. ## News - [2026/07] 🚀 Day 0 support for MiniCPM-Robotic [blog](https://mingti-org.github.io/phyai-blog/blogs/260719-day-0-minicpm-robotic/). - [2026/07] 👏 Introducing PhyAI, a latency-first serving engine for Physical AI. [Read the Blog](https://mingti-org.github.io/phyai-blog/blogs/260718-phyai/). - [2026/07] Support [PI0](https://phyai.mintlify.app/models/pi0/ws1). - [2026/07] Support Cosmos3-Super with TP and CFG parallelism in the unified Cosmos3 [generation path](https://phyai.mintlify.app/models/cosmos/generation). - [2026/06] Support [Pi0.5](https://phyai.mintlify.app/models/pi05/ws1) and Cosmos3-Nano's [policy mode](https://phyai.mintlify.app/models/cosmos/policy) and [generation mode](https://phyai.mintlify.app/models/cosmos/generation). ## Key Features - 🚀 Runs on NVIDIA Jetson edge devices - 🚀 Scales to GPU clusters with DP, TP, and CFG parallelism - 🚀 Uses high-performance kernels from FlashInfer and Humming - 🤗 Supports W4A8 (NVFP4, MXFP4, INT4), W8A8, and W8A16 quantization (PR under review) ## Supported Models VLA π0 , π0.5 (w/ DP), GR00T N1.7 , MiniCPM-Robot WAM Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID (w/ TP, CFG Parallel) Foundation Model Cosmos3-Nano (w/ TP, CFG Parallel), Cosmos3-Super (w/ TP, CFG Parallel), Qwen3.5 , Qwen3-VL ## Performance Comparison ## Installation See the [PhyAI installation guide](https://phyai.mintlify.app/) for the latest source and nightly package instructions. **From source:** **Nightly build:** ## Contribution Guidelines We thank the contributors below and welcome more developers to join us in building PhyAI. ## Sponsors & Adoption PhyAI is a latency-first, open-source serving engine for Physical AI. It is being adopted by companies working across AI infrastructure and robotics, including Mingti and ModelBest. We are activel
abstract_zh: PhyAI是一个用于运行物理AI模型（VLA、WAM等）的高性能框架，支持云端服务和设备端部署。PhyAI（发音为“phi”）是一个面向物理AI的延迟优先服务引擎，专为延迟关键型工作负载（如交互系统中的策略和动作模型）而设计。新闻：2026年7月，对MiniCPM-Robotic提供Day 0支持；推出PhyAI；支持PI0；在统一的Cosmos3生成路径中支持Cosmos3-Super的TP和CFG并行；支持Pi0.5和Cosmos3-Nano的策略模式与生成模式。主要特性：在NVIDIA Jetson边缘设备上运行；通过DP、TP和CFG并行扩展到GPU集群；使用FlashInfer和Humming的高性能内核；支持W4A8（NVFP4、MXFP4、INT4）、W8A8和W8A16量化。支持的模型包括VLA π0、π0.5（带DP）、GR00T N1.7、MiniCPM-Robot WAM、Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID（带TP、CFG并行）、基础模型Cosmos3-Nano（带TP、CFG并行）、Cosmos3-Super（带TP、CFG并行）、Qwen3.5、Qwen3-VL。性能比较见原文。安装指南见官方文档。PhyAI是一个延迟优先的开源物理AI服务引擎，已被明蒂和ModelBest等公司采用。
tldr_zh: PhyAI是面向物理AI的延迟优先服务引擎，支持边缘和云端部署。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：PhyAI是一个延迟优先的Physical AI推理服务引擎，利用FlashInfer和Humming高性能内核，支持DP/TP/CFG并行及W4A8/W8A8/W8A16量化，可部署于NVIDIA Jetson边缘设备或GPU集群。


# 一、动机

> Physical AI模型（如VLA、WAM）在交互系统中需要极低延迟的推理，但现有引擎难以同时满足云端服务和边缘设备的高性能部署需求。


# 二、方法

> PhyAI是一个延迟优先的Physical AI推理服务引擎，利用FlashInfer和Humming高性能内核，支持DP/TP/CFG并行及W4A8/W8A8/W8A16量化，可部署于NVIDIA Jetson边缘设备或GPU集群。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 摘要未给出具体数值；该引擎支持在Jetson上运行π0、π0.5、GR00T N1.7、MiniCPM-Robot等VLA/WAM模型，并支持Cosmos3系列的策略/生成模式，通过DP/TP/CFG并行扩展到GPU集群。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与机器人具身智能推理优化直接相关，可借鉴其延迟优先的系统架构和量化方案；局限是README缺少可复现的性能基准，需参考博客或文档进一步获取数字。
